t: When a number is divided successively by 6, 11, and 14, we get the remainders 3, 4, and 5 respectively. When the same number is divided successively by 14, 11, and 6, we get the remainders A, B, and C respectively. Find the value of (A + B - C).
e: Let the number is N, so when N is divided by 6, the remainder is 3. Let us say that the quotient is x. This x when divided by 11 leaves the remainder 4 and quotient y and when y is divided by 14, it leaves the remainder 5 and quotient z. This can be written as below: N = 6x + 3... (1) X = 11y + 4... (2) y = 14z + 5... (3) Putting equation (3) and (2), X = 154z + 55 + 4 = 154z + 59... (4) Putting equation (4) in (1), N = 6 * (154z + 59) + 3 = 924z + 357. Smallest such number is 357, when z = 0 Therefore, N = 357 Now, 357/14, quotient is 25 and remainder is 7. 25/11, the quotient is 2 and the remainder is 3. 2/6, the quotient is 0 and the remainder is 2. So, A = 7, B = 3, and C = 2 Therefore, A + B - C = 7 + 3 - 2 = 10 - 2 = 8 Express Method Let in the first condition, last quotient be 1. So, dividend for 14 = 14 x 1 + 5 = 19 dividend for 11 = 11 x 19 + 4 = 213 dividend for 6 = 213 x 6 + 3 = 1281 So, the number is 1281. Now, (1281/14) = quotient = 25 and remainder(A) = 7 (25/11) = quotient = 2 and remainder(B) = 3 2/6 = remainder(C) = 2 Therefore, A + B - C = 7 + 3 - 2 = 8
h: जब किसी संख्या को क्रमिक रूप से 6, 11 और 14 से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो हमें क्रमशः 3, 4 और 5 शेषफल प्राप्त होते हैं। जब उसी संख्या को क्रमिक रूप से 14, 11 और 6 से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो हमें क्रमशः A, B और C शेषफल प्राप्त होते हैं। (A + B - C) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: A number when divided successively by 14, 11 and 19, leaves remainders of 5, 9 and 17 respectively, with quotient becoming the dividend for each successive step. When the second smallest such natural number is divided by 25, then what is the remainder?
e: Let k be the integer quotient after the 3 successive divisions Then the number at the end of 2nd successive division must have been of the form (19k + 17) Then the number at the end of 1st division must have been of the form {11(19k + 17) + 9} Then the original number can be represented as 14{11(19k + 17) + 9} + 5. = 14{209k + 187 + 9} + 5 = 14{209k + 196} + 5 = 2926k + 2744 + 5 = 2926k + 2749 Hence second smallest such natural number is 5675, when k = 1. When divided by 25, the remainder shall be 0. Express Method Let the last quotient be 1. The dividend for 19 = 19 x 1 + 17 = 36 The dividend for 11 = 11 x 36 + 9 = 405 The dividend for 14 = 14 x 405 + 5 = 5675 So, the number is 5675. When 5675 is divided by 25, we get 0 as a remainder.
h: एक संख्या जब 14, 11 और 19 से क्रमिक रूप से विभाजित होती है, तो क्रमशः 5, 9 और 17 शेषफल बचता है, प्रत्येक चरण में भागफल भाज्य हो जाता है। जब ऐसी दूसरी सबसे छोटी प्राकृतिक संख्या 25 से विभाजित होती है, तो शेषफल कितना है ?

t: Remainder obtained after dividing a number by 8 is 3 and when the same number is divided by 9, remainder becomes 6. If difference between quotients in both the cases is 2, then find the number.
e:
Let number = N
Let quotient when N is divided by 8 is 'x' and it is given that difference between quotient in both the cases is 2.
Quotient when a number is divided by smaller number is always more than when the same number is divided by greater number.
Hence, quotient when N is divided by 9 is 'x - 2'
We know that:
Dividend = Divisor * Quotient + Remainder
N = 8x + 3 ...... (1)
N = 9 (x - 2) + 6 ...... (2)
From (1) and (2):
8x + 3 = 9 (x - 2) + 6
8x + 3 = 9x - 18 + 6
x = 12 + 3
x = 15
Hence, number = N = 8x + 3
= 8 * 15 + 3
= 123
h: किसी संख्या को 8 से भाग देने पर शेषफल 3 आता है तथा जब उसी संख्या को 9 से भाग दिया जाता है तो शेषफल 6 रह जाता है। यदि दोनों स्थितियों में भागफलों का अंतर 2 है, तो संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: When y is divided by 29, the remainder obtained is 4. What will be the remainder when y<sup>5</sup> is divided by 29?
e: Let us take an example to understand the concept of remainder: When x is divided by y it gives the remainder 'a'. If we are performing any operation on x, then the same operation will be performed on 'a'. Like, the remainder obtained on dividing xn by y is equal to the remainder obtained on diving an by y. Here, remainder 4 is obtained on dividing y by 29. Then, New remainder = remainder obtained when y5/29 = remainder obtained when 45/29 = remainder obtained when 1024/29 = 9
h: जब y को 29 से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो शेषफल 4 प्राप्त होता है। y<sup>5</sup> को 29 से विभाजित करने पर शेषफल कितना होगा?

t: The remainder of the term when divided by 6 is:
e:
When any odd multiple of 3 is divided by 6, it leaves a remainder 3.

Here,
9 is an odd multiple of 3, and all powers of 9 are also odd multiple
of 3

Now;
given term

9+9<sup>2</sup>+⋯⋅+9<sup>[2n+1]</sup>
divided by 6 gives remainder 3+3+⋯⋅3<sup>[2n+1]</sup>

Sum
of any two terms of this Expression divided by 6, thus remainder is
last odd term i.e. 3
h: पद को 6 से भाग देने पर शेषफल प्राप्त होगा:
eh:
जब 3 के किसी विषम गुणज को 6 से भाग दिया जाता है, तो शेषफल 3 बचता है।
यहाँ, 9, 3 का विषम गुणज है, और 9 की सभी घातें भी 3 की विषम गुणज हैं
अब; दिया गया पद
9+9<sup>2</sup>+⋯⋅+9<sup>[2n+1]</sup> को 6 से भाग देने पर शेषफल 3+3+⋯⋅3<sup>[2n+1] </sup>मिलता है
इस व्यंजक के किसी भी दो पदों के योगफल को 6 से भाग देने पर शेषफल अंतिम विषम पद अर्थात् 3 बचता है

t: Find the number when successively divided by 3, 5 and 7 leaves remainder 2,1 and 3, respectively, and the last quotient is 3.
e:
Let the number be N.
• When divided by 3: N = 3 X Q₁ + 2.
• When Q₁ is divided by 5: Q₁ = 5 X Q₂ + 1.
• When Q₂ is divided by 7: Q₂ = 7 X Q₃ + 3, with Q₃ = 3 (given).
Q₂: 7 X 3 + 3 = 21 + 3 = 24.
Then, Q₁ = 5 X 24 + 1 = 120 + 1 = 121.
Finally, N = 3 X 121 + 2 = 363 + 2 = 365.
Option (c) is the correct answer.
h: वह संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए जिसे क्रमिक रूप से 3, 5 और 7 से विभाजित करने पर शेषफल क्रमशः 2, 1 और 3 बचता है तथा अंतिम भागफल 3 है।
eh: क्रमिक भाग = 3,5,7 क्रमिक शेष = 2,1,3 अंतिम भागफल = 3 तो संख्या होगी अतः संख्या 365 है।

t: On dividing a number by 55, we get 28 as the remainder. On dividing the same number by 11, what is the remainder?
e:
Let the number be 'x'
Let the divisor be 'y'
According to formula:-
Dividend = divisor*quotient + remainder
x=55*y + 28
On dividing x from 11,we get:
x ≡ 55y + 28 (mod 11)
x ≡ (55y mod 11) + (28 mod 11)
As 55 ≡ 0 (mod 11), we have:
x≡ 0y + 28 (mod 11)
x ≡ 28 (mod 11)
x ≡ 6
option (d) is the correct answer.
h: किसी संख्या को 55 से भाग देने पर शेषफल 28 प्राप्त होता है। उसी संख्या को 11 से भाग देने पर शेषफल क्या होगा?

t: If two numbers are each divided by the same divisor, then the remainders are 6 and 7, respectively. If the sum of the two numbers be divided by the same divisor, then the remainder is 5. The divisor is:
e: Let divisor = d. Write numbers as: a = qd + 6, b = pd + 7. Then, a + b = (q + p)d+13 . Since the remainder when divided by d is 5, we have: 13 mod d = 5, meaning d divides (13 - 5) = 8. The divisors of 8 are 1, 2, 4, 8. Since remainders 6 and 7 are less than d, d = 8. Option(b) is the correct answer
h: यदि दो संख्याओं को एक ही भाजक से विभाजित किया जाए, तो शेषफल क्रमशः 6 और 7 होगा। यदि दो संख्याओं के योगफल को एक ही भाजक से विभाजित किया जाए, तो शेषफल 5 होगा। भाजक है:

t: After dividing a number successively by 6, 7, and 11, the remainder are 1, 3, and 4. What will be the remainder, if 19 divides the same number (if the last quotient is 1)?
e:
The last quotient is 1.
The number that is divided by 11 = 11 x 1 + 4 = 15
The number that is divided by 7 = 15 x 7 + 3 = 108
The number that is divided by 6 = 108 x 6 + 1 = 649
When we divide 649 by 19, we get 3 as a remainder.
h: किसी संख्या को 6, 7 और 11 से क्रमिक रूप से विभाजित करने पर शेषफल 1, 3 और 4 बचते हैं। यदि उसी संख्या को 19 से विभाजित किया जाए (यदि अंतिम भागफल 1 है) तो शेषफल क्या होगा?

t: A natural number n divides 732 and leaves 12 as a remainder. How many values of n are possible?
e:
732 = n * q + 12
n * q = 720
Factors of 720 = 2<sup>4</sup> * 3<sup>2</sup>*5
Total number of factors = (4 + 1)(2 + 1)(1 + 1) = 30
Factors less than or equal to 12 = 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 12 = total 10
So, possible values of n = 30 - 10 = 20
h: एक प्राकृतिक संख्या n, 732 को विभाजित करने पर शेष 12 बचाती है। n के कितने मान संभव हैं?

t: When 200 is divided by a positive integer x. The remainder is 12. How many values of x are possible?
e:
If 200 divided by x gives remainder 12, thus [200 - 12]=188

Will be divisible by x then factors of 188 are,

=1,2,4,47,94,188

But we need a number greater than 12 i.e. = 47,94,188

∴ Possible values of x= 3
h: जब 200 को एक धनात्मक पूर्णांक x से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो शेषफल 12 बचता है। x के कितने मान संभव हैं?
eh:
यदि 200 को x से भाग देने पर शेष 12 प्राप्त होता है, तो [200 - 12] = 188

x से विभाज्य होगा, तो 188 के गुणनखंड हैं,

=1,2,4,47,94,188

लेकिन हमें 12 से बड़ी संख्या की आवश्यकता है, अर्थात = 47,94,188

∴ x के संभावित मान = 3

t: The difference between the two numbers is 1370. On dividing the larger by the smaller, the quotient is 7 and the remainder is 14. Find the smaller number.
e: Let smaller number = x Largest number = 1370 + x Divisor | Dividend | Quotient | Rem x | 1370 + x | 7 | 14 Divi. = Divis. * Quo. + Rem. 7x + 14 = x + 1370 6x = 1356 x = 226 Smaller no. = 226
h: दो संख्याओं के बीच का अंतर 1370 है। बड़ी संख्या को छोटी संख्या से भाग देने पर भागफल 7 और शेषफल 14 आता है। छोटी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: When the integer n is divided by 18, the quotient is x and the remainder is 6. When the integer n is divided by 25, the quotient is y and the remainder is 15. Which of the following is true?
e:
We know dividend = Divisor*quotient + remainder
n = 18x + 6 = 25y + 15.
18x + 6 = 25y + 15
18x - 25y = 15 - 6 = 9.
So 18x -25y = 9
Option (d) is the correct answer.
h: जब पूर्णांक n को 18 से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो भागफल x होता है और शेष 6 होता है। जब पूर्णांक n को 25 से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो भागफल y होता है और शेष 15 होता है। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा सत्य है?

t:
In
a division sum, the divisor is 10 times the quotient and four times
the remainder. What is the dividend if the remainder is 45?
e:
Dividend = Divisor×Quotient + Remainder
Divisor = 4×45
The divisor is 10 times the quotient:
⇒4×45 = 10×q
⇒ q=18
Dividend = 4×45×18+45 = 3285
h: भागफल के योग में भाजक भागफल का 10 गुना तथा शेष का चार गुना होता है। यदि शेष 45 है तो भाज्य क्या होगा?

t: There are two numbers a and b such that a>b. a exceeds b by one-third of b. If a is divided by b, quotient is 1 and remainder is 250. Find the smaller number.
e:
Since, a > b
a - b = b/3
a = b + b/3= 4b/3, and
a = 1*b + 250
Hence, b + 25= 4b/3
3b + 750 = 4b
b = 750 (smaller number).
h: दो संख्याएँ a और b इस प्रकार हैं कि a>b है। a, b से b के एक-तिहाई से अधिक है। यदि a को b से विभाजित किया जाता है, तो भागफल 1 और शेषफल 250 प्राप्त होता है। छोटी संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
